rating.verdict: Classic mono-black midrange with good core cards like Vampire Nighthawk and Ravenous Chupacabra. Fine for casual play, slow for competitive.
strengths: Nightmare and Dread Shade become huge with Swamps
weaknesses: Doom Blade can't hit black creatures
Few ways to recover from falling behind early

wins: Trade efficiently with deathtouch creatures and removal, refill your hand, then take over with Nightmare and Vampire Nighthawk in the air.
plan: Typhoid Rats (deathtouch blocker), Walking Corpse; Mind Rot their hand.
Vampire Nighthawk, Phyrexian Rager (a card), Ravenous Chupacabra (destroys a creature). Doom Blade or Murder the rest.
Gravedigger brings back your best creature; Nightmare and Dread Shade grow with your Swamps.
keys: A flier whose power and toughness equal your Swamps: often 6/6 or bigger.
Pump it with black mana: B: +1/+1. A huge late-game threat.
Flying, deathtouch, lifelink: great on offense and defense.
tips: Doom Blade can’t hit black creatures; use Murder on those.
Typhoid Rats trade with anything: they make attacking into you painful.
Sign in Blood draws two (or makes the opponent lose 2 to finish them).
Keep Swamps coming: every one grows Nightmare and powers Dread Shade.
mulligan: Keep 3–4 Swamps with a cheap creature or removal spell.
